title: Chang Shan-cheng Praises Model Fathers, Thanks Them for Using Love and Responsibility to Support Happy Families
summary: At the Taoyuan City Model Father Awards ceremony, 48 nominated fathers were honored by Mayor Chang Shan-cheng, including 93-year-old Liang Chun-yu who devoted his life to the nation and family, and 57-year-old Jiang Tian-ci and 53-year-old Li Xinquan who have long accompanied their children with disabilities in growing up, demonstrating selfless paternal love.
